about: Hand-worked cases of the smart alarm's rule (DECISIONS 230-232), read by app/test/alarm_rule_test.dart and analysis/tests/test_smart_alarm.py. stages: one character per live epoch from epoch 0 (W 1 2 3 R, '-' lost); the stage of epoch e is handed out at max(e + 1 + behind, 10) * 30 s (the live scorer's first call comes once 10 epochs are in, read 4 behind); window: [start, end) in seconds on the same clock. expect: the wake (epoch read, why, seconds); a window-end wake has no epoch.

cases.name: light sleep inside the window wakes at once
deep sleep all through: the window's end
not within 10 minutes after a deep epoch
dream sleep wakes, after the deep guard
awake counts; lost epochs never wake
only lost epochs: the window's end
light sleep before the window does not wake
deep sleep in the hour before the window still guards
deep sleep when the window opens: no wake inside it
light sleep allowed only at the window's end: the end wins
a deep epoch inside the window restarts the guard
